reviews.name: Elena R.
reviews.quote: Our AC died on a 104 degree day. They were here by 2 and the house was cool by dinner. The price was on the tablet before anyone touched a tool.

reviews.name: Marcus D.
reviews.quote: Water heater started leaking on a Sunday. They answered, came out, and had a new one in by Monday at noon. Zero mess.

reviews.name: Janet K.
reviews.quote: Another company said we needed a whole new furnace. Sunrise found a bad igniter and fixed it for a fraction of that. Honest people.

faqs.q: How fast can you get here?
faqs.a: Most homes in Manteca, Lathrop, and Ripon get a same-day visit. Stockton and Modesto are usually same day or next morning.

faqs.q: Will I know the price before you start?
faqs.a: Yes. You approve the full price before we pick up a tool. No hourly surprises.

faqs.q: Do you work on all brands?
faqs.a: Yes. We service every major brand of AC, furnace, heat pump, and water heater.

owner.name: Dana Whitfield
owner.story: Dana opened Sunrise in Manteca in 2014 after ten years installing systems for bigger shops. The idea was simple: show up when we say, give the price first, and treat every house like our own. Today a small crew covers 10 cities across San Joaquin and Stanislaus counties.
owner.quote: If something is not right, call me. I answer my own phone.
